note: These thresholds are project-defined, illustrative assumptions for flagging concentration - they are not universal financial rules, regulatory limits or advice. Change them here; the dashboard and tests read this file.
position_spread_note: Position Spread Score = min(100, effective number of positions / target x 100), where effective number = 1 / sum(weight^2) (inverse Herfindahl-Hirschman index). It measures how evenly money is spread across positions only - not sector diversification and not return correlations.
coverage_note: The composite portfolio score is shown only when at least this share of the priced portfolio value has a financial-health score; otherwise it is labelled a partial assessment.
price_max_age_note: A price older than this (calendar days, covering weekends and short holidays) is stale and is not used as a current market price.
